claims.text: The selected sharing layer is trained using a sifted multi-task learning method that incorporates a gated sharing cell and an attention sharing cell to filter and select shared features for specific tasks.

The gated sharing cell filters out useless features, while the attention sharing cell focuses on valuable features, enhancing the model's performance in tasks like fake news detection and stance detection.
The model utilizes a transformer encoder to improve the encoding of input representations, which aids in capturing long-range dependencies and enhances training efficiency.
